messages.subject: Rattle Updates - 2.1.116
parts:
It has been a little while since I have updated the list of changes to
Rattle.

Although I've been quiet on the list, Rattle development has continued
quite actively.

I continue to get very good suggestions emailed me. Feel free to email
them also to this list.

What really helps is when R code is also supplied along with the
suggestion. These are generally incorporated sooner than if I need to
work it out for myself!

Anyhow, here is a summary of some recent activity. You can also see a
brief list at the Rattle web site at
http://rattle.togaware.com/changes.html

Imputation: Initial, very simple, framework for imputation being
implemented. Currently you can impute missings as zero or as a
categorical value "Missing". Currently exploring mix for more
sophisticated imputation. Would be helpful if anyone has suggestions
on common practise.

Boosting: I have replaced use of the GBM package with the ada package
for boosting. This is more atuned to binary classifications, and the
results look very good. Often obtaining better results than randon
forests in many real world datasets.

Associate: Implemented support for loading a "transactional" dataset
for apriori association rules. Such a dataset generally consists of
two columns, an ID and an Item, and the items are aggregated into
baskets identified by the IDs.

Evaluate: The ROC curves when plotting a single model performance will
now show both the performance on the training and test datasets.

Forest: Identification of issues around entities with missing values
will be brought to the attention of the user. Currently not using the
randomForest imputation methods, but being explored. Anyone with
experience?

Neural: A basic neural network framework has been implemented, but not
yet epxosed in the interface. Doesn't yet quite fit the paradigm.
Again, anyone who has experience with nnet is invited to get in touch
to help me iron out its usage.

Project: Save ada projects and properly restore model selections on
loading a project.

Data: CSV files without a headers row can now be imported.

Model: All model building now reports time taken, both in the status
bar and in the log file.
